name: skeleton
purpose: Decorative loading placeholders (text lines, rectangles, circles) hidden from assistive technology, with a static helper to mark the loading region aria-busy. Sizes are strictly validated CSS lengths written through the CSSOM.
whenToUse: Reserving layout for content that is loading, to reduce layout shift.
Lists, cards, and profile headers whose shape is known in advance.
whenNotToUse: As the only loading feedback for assistive technology: pair with a visually hidden status (Spinner).
responsive: Width defaults to 100% of the container (circle: 2.5rem) and never exceeds it; lines use a em-based height.
rtl: Logical properties; the shorter last text line ends at the inline end of its content.
theme: Placeholders use color-active (distinct from page and surface backgrounds in every built-in theme), pulsing toward color-hover; radius-sm for lines and rectangles, radius-pill for circles. Forced-colors mode uses GrayText without animation.
security: Only lengths matching ^\d+(\.\d+)?(px|rem|em|%|ch)$ are accepted and are applied as custom properties through the CSSOM; no style attribute strings or CSS functions can be injected.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.
limitations: The pulse is disabled automatically under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
Only px, rem, em, %, and ch lengths are accepted.
unsupported: CSS functions (calc, var, clamp) as sizes.
antiPatterns: Skeletons without aria-busy on the region and an announced status.
Skeletons that do not resemble the final layout.
Leaving skeletons in place after loading fails; show an error instead.
